body.zh-Hant: 范·赫茨1851年2月3日生於科弗登，父親是砲兵軍官；因家境困難沒有取得進軍校所需的預備教育，1867年轉入坎彭的教導營服役，1870年在馬斯垂克步兵部隊任軍需士，1872年晉升少尉。他出於冒險心於1873年報名加入荷屬東印度軍，並被派到泗水的第13步兵營。
body.en: Van Heutsz was born in Coevorden on 3 February 1851, the son of an artillery officer. Financial difficulties denied him the schooling needed for the military academy, so he entered the Instruction Battalion at Kampen in 1867 and was posted as a fourier to the infantry at Maastricht in 1870. He was promoted second lieutenant in 1872 and in 1873 joined the Netherlands Indies army, assigned to the 13th Infantry Battalion at Surabaya.

Zoon van Joannes Franciscus van Heutsz, artillerie-officier
trad Van Heutsz in 1867 in dienst bij het Instructie Bataljon in Kampen
in 1870 werd hij als fourier geplaatst bij de Infanterie in Maastricht
Toch verhinderde dat in 1872 zijn bevordering tot 2e luitenant niet
meldde hij zich in 1873 voor het Nederlandsch-Indische leger
waar hij bij het 13e Infanterie Bataljon werd geplaatst

heading.zh-Hant: 亞齊戰事與參謀長任職
heading.en: Aceh campaigns and the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 他多次被派往亞齊作戰：1876年因戰功獲軍事威廉勳章；1889年第三次調往亞齊，以憲兵隊採反游擊戰術；1893年出版小冊子《亞齊的征服》，主張以軍事手段解決亞齊問題。1895年1月起任蘇門答臘東海岸軍事指揮官，駐棉蘭；1897年6月至1898年12月任巴達維亞的參謀長。
body.en: He was repeatedly sent to Aceh: he received the Military William Order in 1876, was posted to Aceh a third time in 1889 and fought with counter-guerrilla tactics, and published the pamphlet De onderwerping van Atjeh in 1893 arguing for a military solution. From January 1895 he was military commander of Sumatra's East Coast at Medan, and from June 1897 to December 1898 he was chief of the General Staff at Batavia.

citations.quote: in 1876 uit de toekenning van de Militaire Willemsorde
werd hij in 1889 voor de derde maal naar Atjeh overgeplaatst
bestreed hij de Atjehers met hun eigen tactiek: de contra-guerrilla
De onderwerping van Atjeh ('s-Gravenhage [enz.], 1893)
Sumatra's Oostkust te Medan, van januari 1895 tot juni 1897
chef Generale Staf te Batavia, van juni 1897 tot december 1898

body.zh-Hant: 1898年12月起，范·赫茨任亞齊及屬地的文武總督，到1904年10月1日止。傳記辭典記載，1899年亞齊抗戰領袖鳥古·烏瑪在一次攻擊中陣亡；他最終於1904年完成對亞齊的「綏靖」。議會資料庫也指出，綏靖過程中約有7萬當地人死亡，使他後來成為殘酷殖民統治的象徵。
body.en: From December 1898 he served as civil and military governor of Aceh and its dependencies, until 1 October 1904. The biographical dictionary records that the Acehnese leader Teuku Umar fell in an attack in 1899; he completed the 'pacification' of Aceh in 1904. The parliamentary database adds that about 70,000 local people died in the process, which later made him a symbol of a harsh colonial regime.

citations.quote: van december 1898 tot 1 oktober 1904
generaal-majoor en benoemd tot civiel en militair Gouverneur van Atjeh
In 1899 sneuvelde bij een van die aanvallen Teukoe Oemar
Voltooide in 1904 de 'pacificatie' van Atjeh
bij de pacificatie circa 70.000 inlanders omkwamen

body.zh-Hant: 1904年他被任命為荷屬東印度總督，任期自1904年10月1日至1909年12月18日；此段任期已在名單5442內，不重建。傳記辭典稱，他讓外島尚獨立的諸王公簽署「短宣言」，無條件服從荷蘭權威，並被稱為帝國建造者；他於1909年底卸任後定居阿姆斯特丹。
body.en: In 1904 he was appointed Governor-General of the Netherlands Indies, serving from 1 October 1904 to 18 December 1909; this term is already in list 5442 and is not rebuilt. The biographical dictionary says he had the still-independent rulers of the outer islands sign 'short declarations' submitting unconditionally to Dutch authority, and describes him as an empire-builder; he stepped down at the end of 1909 and settled in Amsterdam.

citations.quote: van 1 oktober 1904 tot 18 december 1909
In 1904 volgde de beloning voor alle moeite en ambities
door middel van het doen tekenen van 'korte verklaringen'
Als imperiumbouwer had Van Heutsz zijn grote verdienste
Eind 1909 trad Van Heutsz af als gouverneur-generaal
vestigde zich in Amsterdam

body.zh-Hant: 1919年妻子去世後，他退出公共生活；1922年起輪流住在蒙特勒與梅蘭。他於1924年7月11日在蒙特勒去世，1927年6月9日在阿姆斯特丹改葬，是唯一獲得國葬的非王室荷蘭人。
body.en: After his wife died in 1919 he withdrew from public life, and from 1922 he lived alternately in Montreux and Meran. He died in Montreux on 11 July 1924 and was reburied in Amsterdam on 9 June 1927, the only non-royal Dutchman to receive a state funeral.

citations.quote: Na de dood van zijn vrouw in 1919 trok hij zich terug uit het openbare leven
Vanaf 1922 woonde hij beurtelings in Montreux en Meran.
Montreux, 11 juli 1924
Amsterdam, 9 juni 1927
De enige niet-koninklijke Nederlander die een staatsbegrafenis kreeg

body.zh-Hant: 利奧波德二世1835年4月9日生於布魯塞爾，是比利時國王利奧波德一世與第二任妻子露易絲的長子。1846年成為布拉班特公爵（王儲），開始軍事訓練；1853年與奧地利大公約瑟夫之女瑪麗·亨麗埃特結婚；1865年父親去世後加冕為國王。
body.en: Leopold II was born in Brussels on 9 April 1835, eldest son of King Leopold I and his second wife Louise. He became Duke of Brabant, the crown prince, in 1846 and began his military training; in 1853 he married Marie Henriette, daughter of the Austrian Archduke Joseph; and after his father's death in 1865 he was crowned king.

1853 Heirat mit Maria Henrietta, Tochter des österreichischen Erzherzogs Joseph.
1865 Nach dem Tod seines Vaters
wird er als Leopold II. zum König von Belgien gekrönt.

heading.en: Domestic politics and the Congo project

body.zh-Hant: 執政初期，國會就選舉權與教育問題爭論不休；1870至71年普法戰爭期間他主張比利時中立，1871年起著力加強國防。1876年他創立「國際剛果協會」，委託史丹利代表；1885年2月26日剛果會議以《剛果法案》確認剛果自由邦為他的私人財產。
body.en: The early years of his reign were marked by growing parliamentary disputes over suffrage and education; during the Franco-Prussian War of 1870-71 he argued for Belgian neutrality, and from 1871 he concentrated on national defence. In 1876 he founded the International Association of the Congo, represented by Henry Morton Stanley, and on 26 February 1885 the Congo Conference confirmed the Congo Free State as his private property.

citations.quote: 1865-1870 Die ersten Jahre seiner Regierungszeit
parlamentarischen Auseinandersetzungen über Wahlrechts- und Bildungsfragen

26. Februar: Die sogenannte Kongo-Konferenz endet mit der "Kongo-Akte"

heading.en: Criticism of the Congo, transfer, and death

body.zh-Hant: 1895年起國際橡膠需求為他帶來鉅額收入，國際媒體也批評他施行的強迫勞動制度。1908年11月，在他同意下，這個中非國家歸比利時國家所有，改稱比屬剛果。他於1909年12月17日在拉肯去世；名單5442內的元首任期（1908年1月1日至1909年12月17日）不重建。
body.en: From 1895 the growing world demand for rubber brought him vast revenues, and the international press criticised the system of forced labour he had introduced. In November 1908, with his consent, the Central African state passed into the possession of the Belgian state and was renamed Belgian Congo. He died at Laeken on 17 December 1909; his head-of-state term in list 5442 (1 January 1908 to 17 December 1909) is not rebuilt.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔（GND）把普雷斯托爾登錄為波蘭軍官與政治家，1874年生於維爾諾，1941年卒於莫斯科；美國國會圖書館權威檔也登錄為「Prystor, Aleksander, 1874-1941」。他是畢蘇斯基多年的朋友，兩人在波蘭社會黨（PPS）戰鬥組織時期便已相識。
body.en: The German National Library's authority file (GND) records Prystor as a Polish officer and politician, born in Vilnius in 1874 and died in Moscow in 1941; the Library of Congress authority file likewise lists him as 'Prystor, Aleksander, 1874-1941'. He was a long-standing friend of Piłsudski, dating from the days of the PPS Combat Organization.

wieloletniego przyjaciela jeszcze z czasów Organizacji Bojowej PPS

body.zh-Hant: 波蘭科學院歷史研究所期刊的論文以「1931年5月27日至1933年5月9日的共和國總理」稱呼普雷斯托爾。論文指出，1926年後畢蘇斯基在所有內閣中擔任軍事部長，所以畢蘇斯基若退出政府，就會連帶使總理和其他部長去職；總理任內他的處境因此取決於畢蘇斯基的信任。此段總理任期已在名單5442內，不重建。
body.en: A paper in the journal of the Polish Academy of Sciences' Institute of History refers to Prystor as prime minister of the Republic from 27 May 1931 to 9 May 1933. It notes that after 1926 Piłsudski was minister of military affairs in every cabinet, so his withdrawal from the government would bring down the prime minister and the other ministers; Prystor's position therefore depended on Piłsudski's confidence. This prime-ministerial term is already in list 5442 and is not rebuilt.

citations.quote: premier Rzeczypospolitej 27 V 1931 – 9 V 1933
citations.evidenceNote: 引自論文註腳中所列參考文獻的標題；起日 1931-05-27 與庫值一致

citations.quote: Piłsudski sprawował bowiem funkcję ministra spraw wojskowych
we wszystkich gabinetach

body.zh-Hant: Duber認為，普雷斯托爾辭去總理與他失去畢蘇斯基的信任有關。1933年4月畢蘇斯基未通知總理，就決定艾米爾·卡林斯基出任郵電部長，使普雷斯托爾面對既成事實；總理最後決定在總統莫希奇基再度當選後遞交內閣辭呈，畢蘇斯基於1933年5月迫使他辭職。
body.en: Duber argues that Prystor's resignation as prime minister was linked to his losing Piłsudski's trust. In April 1933 Piłsudski named Emil Kaliński minister of posts and telegraphs without informing the prime minister, presenting Prystor with a fait accompli; Prystor decided to submit the cabinet's resignation just after President Mościcki's re-election, and Piłsudski forced him to resign in May 1933.

stawiając tym samym Prystora przed faktem dokonanym
